rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Detection {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic Cobalt Strike beacon characteristics"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
        malpedia_version = "20260409"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"
        confidence = 90
        enabled = true
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 6A 00 68 [2] 00 00 68 [4] E8 [4] 83 C4 0C } // Classic beacon config push
        $c2_uri_get = "GET /%s/%s" fullword ascii
        $c2_uri_post = "POST /%s/%s" fullword ascii
        $injection_api = "NtCreateSection" wide ascii
        $mutex_pattern = "Global\\MSCTF.Asm.{" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and (2 of ($beacon_config, $c2_uri_get, $c2_uri_post)) and $injection_api and $mutex_pattern
}

rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic_Packed_DLL {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic packed DLLs often used by Cobalt Strike"
        author = "SOC Team"
        confidence = "medium"
        false_positive_rate = "high"
        reference_hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2"
    strings:
        $s1 = "This program cannot be run in DOS mode" wide ascii
        $s2 = { 4D 5A ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? 80 } //MZ header with large checksum
        $s3 = "System.Security.Cryptography" wide
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and 
        filesize < 500KB and 
        not pe.imphash() == "f34d5f2d4577ed6d9ceec516c1f5a744" and // Known good imphash
        2 of ($s*)
}
